def border_transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=max({x for row in grid for x in row}, key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if not pts:return out
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    for r in (r0,r1):
        cs=[c for rr,c in pts if rr==r]
        if cs:
            for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1):
                if out[r][c]==bg:out[r][c]=2
    for c in (c0,c1):
        rs=[r for r,cc in pts if cc==c]
        if rs:
            for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1):
                if out[r][c]==bg:out[r][c]=2
    return out

new_program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {value for row in grid for value in row}
    background = max(colors, key=lambda color: sum(row.count(color) for row in grid))
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points)

    for r in (r0, r1):
        columns = [c for rr, c in points if rr == r]
        for c in range(min(columns), max(columns) + 1):
            if out[r][c] == background:
                out[r][c] = 2
    for c in (c0, c1):
        rows = [r for r, cc in points if cc == c]
        for r in range(min(rows), max(rows) + 1):
            if out[r][c] == background:
                out[r][c] = 2

    border_filled = [row[:] for row in out]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            if (border_filled[r][c] == background and
                    border_filled[r][c - 1] != background and
                    border_filled[r][c + 1] != background):
                out[r][c] = 2
    for c in range(w):
        for r in range(1, h - 1):
            if (border_filled[r][c] == background and
                    border_filled[r - 1][c] != background and
                    border_filled[r + 1][c] != background):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
